headroom.definition: Value of an outcome-informed selector that reads one complete independent draw of every arm and is scored on another; an honest reference for what any prefix-conditional policy can reach at this draw count

exchangeable_label_floor.definition: Within-task permutation of every arm/draw outcome; the sharp null of exchangeable arm and draw labels

variance_profile.definition: Tasks binned by the variance of a Bernoulli with their pooled arm-by-draw success rate; the diagnostic is a function of that variance
